title: Build out corpus annotations to 200 per category
description: Expand the benchmark corpus from 150 annotations (75 positive) across 10 repos to at least 200 accepted annotations per category across raw_hits, mentions, data_items, data_flows, and components. Current gaps: raw_hits 0, mentions 0, data_flows 0, components 3, data_items 147 spread thin. Use Composer 2.5 swarm for grunt annotation proposals, Grok 4.6 for refinement, human for final approval.
